value.rationale: The Ritz gap versus residual/distortion balance gives a usable all-real spectrum guard for compressed projection of symmetric problems. The exact Gram extremizer proves its best possible universal constant and locates a defective eigenvalue collision separating real and complex outputs. This clarifies when real spectral extraction remains justified and when a real Schur mechanism can be necessary even for SPD inputs, in a way not supplied by qualitative counterexamples.
